title: The infrastructure behind institutional-scale investment flows
summary: Find out how investment platforms managing billions across hundreds of LPs and SPVs can eliminate the manual overhead of chasing wires.
body_markdown: Investment platforms managing capital across hundreds of LPs and SPVs face a compounding infrastructure problem: as deal volume grows, so does the operational burden of manually reconciling wires, onboarding new relationships, and managing deposit concentration risk across a single banking partner. The platforms that scale without breaking are the ones that build on infrastructure designed for institutional complexity from day one.Download our[case study](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/600b2a653e800f6ea70d169a/6a0496924aa2b5806e0a7db1_Treasury%20Prime_The%20infrastructure%20behind%20institutional%20scale%20investment%20flows.pdf) to see how one investment platform manages over $1B in deposits across three banking partners — with 192K accounts, instant traceable capital calls, and zero single point of failure — and learn how Treasury Prime's multi-bank architecture can give your investment platform the same foundation.
